properties.site-address: Land and Buildings at Former Cuttler Hammer Factory and Tumbling Weir Hotel Car Park, Ottery St Mary
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Part of a Floodzone 2; townhouses under construction and building work started on car park and the conversion of the old switchgear factory. Redevelopment of parcels of land making up the overall former Cuttler Hammer factory site and Tumbling Weir hotel car park; comprising conversion of building to 30 apartments, construction of 33 new dwellings and 29 retirement apartments
